summary:
Iteration 5 validates live-domain resolution for host embed iframes. Backend: 28/28 pytest pass (added TestResolvedUrl class - 3 new cases). GET /api/embed/SMioOAxb returns DoodStream embed_url on the resolved live domain (playmogo.com/e/9bvi9u4wu0j1), NOT the stored dsvplay.com stub. Creating a new mirror with 'https://dsvplay.com/d/ysledj039kb4' is (a) normalized on save to 'https://dsvplay.com/e/ysledj039kb4', and (b) after the first /embed hit, resolved_url is persisted on the mirror doc and served as embed_url ('/e/ysledj039kb4' on the resolved live domain, dsvplay.com removed). POST /api/mirrors/<id>/check also stores resolved_url and returns status=online for the Cloudflare-protected host. Regressions all green: URL normalization (/d, /embed, bare id, query preserved, unknown multi-segment untouched), Cloudflare 403 not marked offline while genuine 404 still offline, ES/US geo-ordering unchanged, admin login + CRUD unchanged, site settings unchanged.

Frontend: On /e/SMioOAxb the iframe attributes are correct: referrerPolicy='no-referrer', sandbox attribute NOT present, allowFullScreen=true, allow='autoplay; encrypted-media; fullscreen; picture-in-picture'. Clicking host-tab-doodstream flips iframe src to 'https://playmogo.com/e/9bvi9u4wu0j1' (resolved live domain). Clicking host-tab-voe flips back to 'https://voe.sx/e/rjseg1wmsyv6'. All attributes preserved across tab switches.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_embed(): resolve-on-demand loop calls probe_url synchronously in thread pool for each link that lacks resolved_url. First-time public viewers of a fresh mirror will experience ~10s latency per unresolved link. Consider background pre-resolve on create_mirror to avoid blocking the initial /embed request, or return the unresolved URL immediately and resolve asynchronously.

server.py probe_url(): status='unknown' for 403 challenge pages is correct, but final_url returned by requests when the challenge redirects may in some cases still be the intermediate host (e.g. if Cloudflare interstitial is served on the pre-redirect domain). Currently working for dsvplay.com->playmogo.com because dsvplay issues an HTTP redirect BEFORE the CF challenge; document this assumption.

server.py check_mirror + get_embed both mutate `l` in place and $set the whole links array — safe here since single-writer per mirror, but could race with the background offline_checker. Low risk for MVP.
No test coverage for concurrent /embed hits on an unresolved mirror (potential duplicate probe requests). Acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - iframe attrs + tab switching + live-domain resolution verified

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ResolveLive and TEST_CheckResolved mirrors inside TestResolvedUrl; both deleted in finally blocks. Seeded mirrors SMioOAxb and -B7RoZcD preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5: probe_url returns (status, final_url); resolved_url persisted on /check and lazily on /embed. Frontend iframe uses referrerPolicy='no-referrer', no sandbox. DoodStream dsvplay.com/d/ysledj039kb4 resolves to playmogo.com/e/9bvi9u4wu0j1. All 28 backend tests + frontend iframe/tab-switch checks pass.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature working. Behavior: (1) probe_url follows redirects and returns final_url (dsvplay.com HTTP-redirects to playmogo.com before serving Cloudflare challenge); (2) check_mirror stores final_url as resolved_url; (3) get_embed lazily resolves unresolved links on first hit and persists; (4) response embed_url = resolved_url or original; (5) iframe uses referrerPolicy=no-referrer without sandbox so playmogo.com receives no Referer header and no framing sandbox.
